role.en: Backend engineer who ships design and motion too
role.id: Backend engineer yang juga menggarap desain dan motion

intro.en: I build server-side systems for civic and education products, then take the same work through interface design, colour, and edit-room pacing until it feels finished.
intro.id: Saya membangun sistem sisi server untuk produk publik dan pendidikan, lalu membawanya lewat desain antarmuka, warna, dan ritme ruang edit sampai terasa tuntas.

statement.en: Three disciplines, one habit: reduce until only the load-bearing parts remain.
statement.id: Tiga disiplin, satu kebiasaan: kurangi sampai tinggal bagian yang menopang.

summary.en: Interactive map of heritage sites, intangible cultural heritage, and cultural advancement objects across Probolinggo Regency.
summary.id: Peta interaktif cagar budaya, WBTB, dan objek pemajuan kebudayaan Kabupaten Probolinggo.

metric.id: Cakupan satu kabupaten, filter peta berlapis

summary.en: Web photobooth: capture selfies, compose them into custom frames, export PNG, share by link.
summary.id: Photobooth web: ambil selfie, susun ke frame custom, ekspor PNG, bagikan lewat tautan.

metric.id: Render sisi server + tautan bagi kedaluwarsa

summary.en: SINAD+ parent companion app for early ADHD observation, built around short structured checklists.
summary.id: Aplikasi pendamping orang tua SINAD+ untuk observasi dini ADHD, berbasis checklist terstruktur singkat.

summary.en: Asset and inventory tracking for early-childhood schools, replacing spreadsheet handoffs.
summary.id: Pencatatan aset dan inventaris sekolah PAUD, mengganti serah-terima lewat spreadsheet.

summary.en: Submits dummy CSV responses to Google Forms you own, so QA can test flows without manual clicking.
summary.id: Mengirim respons CSV dummy ke Google Form milik sendiri, agar QA bisa uji alur tanpa klik manual.

metric.en: Open source, used for QA runs
metric.id: Open source, dipakai untuk uji QA

summary.en: Education platform backend with REST endpoints consumed by a companion mobile client.
summary.id: Backend platform pendidikan dengan endpoint REST yang dikonsumsi klien mobile pendamping.

summary.en: WhatsApp notification bridge for organisation workflows: reminders, task states, group mentions.
summary.id: Jembatan notifikasi WhatsApp untuk alur kerja organisasi: pengingat, status tugas, mention grup.

summary.en: Rental management web app covering catalogue, booking, and return states.
summary.id: Aplikasi web manajemen rental mencakup katalog, pemesanan, dan status pengembalian.

note.en: Legend, marker hierarchy, and a muted basemap so heritage layers stay legible at every zoom.
note.id: Legenda, hierarki marker, dan basemap redup agar lapisan cagar budaya tetap terbaca di tiap zoom.

note.en: Klasik, Neon, and Polaroid frames drawn as SVG across 16:9, 9:16, and 1:3 strip ratios.
note.id: Frame Klasik, Neon, dan Polaroid digambar sebagai SVG untuk rasio 16:9, 9:16, dan strip 1:3.

note.en: Large tap targets and calm contrast for parents filling checklists on a phone, one hand, low light.
note.id: Target sentuh besar dan kontras tenang untuk orang tua mengisi checklist di ponsel, satu tangan, cahaya redup.

note.en: Single-column narrative page: one idea per scroll block, type doing the layout work.
note.id: Halaman naratif satu kolom: satu gagasan per blok scroll, tipografi yang menata layout.

note.en: Alumni platform structure: directory, chapters, events. Design driven by the data model, not the reverse.
note.id: Struktur platform alumni: direktori, komisariat, acara. Desain mengikuti model data, bukan sebaliknya.

note.en: Command grammar and reply tone for an assistant bot: short, unambiguous, never chatty.
note.id: Tata bahasa perintah dan nada balasan bot asisten: singkat, tidak ambigu, tidak bertele-tele.

note.en: Cut on crowd energy: wide establish, three beats per act, music-locked transitions.
note.id: Potong mengikuti energi massa: wide pembuka, tiga beat per babak, transisi terkunci musik.

note.en: Zoom-and-hold on the exact UI element being explained, captions carrying the narration weight.
note.id: Zoom-dan-tahan tepat pada elemen UI yang dijelaskan, caption memikul beban narasi.

note.en: Hook in the first 1.5 seconds, one message, no dead frame before the payoff.
note.id: Hook di 1,5 detik pertama, satu pesan, tanpa frame kosong sebelum penutup.

note.en: Reusable lower-thirds and title cards driven by expressions instead of hand-keyed frames.
note.id: Lower-third dan title card reusable digerakkan expression, bukan keyframe manual.

body.en: C# coursework and algorithm practice pushed to GitHub every week. Learning by leaving a trail.
body.id: Tugas C# dan latihan algoritma dipush ke GitHub tiap pekan. Belajar dengan meninggalkan jejak.

body.en: Laravel rental app, static sites, and sticker tools — the year the whole stack became mine.
body.id: Aplikasi rental Laravel, situs statis, dan tool stiker — tahun ketika seluruh stack jadi milik sendiri.

body.en: Heritage mapping, PAUD inventory, ADHD observation, WhatsApp automation, photobooth. Design and video ride along.
body.id: Pemetaan cagar budaya, inventaris PAUD, observasi ADHD, otomasi WhatsApp, photobooth. Desain dan video ikut serta.

body.en: Building an alumni platform as thesis work: directory, chapter management, and event flows.
body.id: Membangun platform alumni sebagai skripsi: direktori, manajemen komisariat, dan alur acara.
